notes.title: Final Discount Before Removal and Some Changes to Level 1
notes.content: [h2]I would like to announce that this is the final discount before the game is removed from Steam on [b]September 15, 2025[/b].[/h2][p][/p][h2]The game will still be playable for everyone who purchased it, even after it is removed from the store.[/h2][p][/p][h2]Additionally, I’ve made some changes to [b]Level 1[/b] to make it easier.[/h2][p][/p][h2]Thanks,[/h2]

notes.title: Rolly will be removed from Steam on September 15, 2025.
notes.content: [h2]I would like to announce that Rolly will be removed from Steam on September 15, 2025.[/h2][p][/p][h2]The game will still be playable for those who purchased it, even after it is removed.[/h2][p][/p][h2]Sadly, the game did not succeed, and I don’t think it’s worth keeping it on Steam.[/h2]
